source.reference: The in-flight scope rule: a diff into a different package halts execution and the contract must be revised, whatever the expansion budget says

defect: The change edits packages/billing/src/charge.ts, a package the plan never declared, alongside its declared work in packages/text.
why_it_is_hard: The edit is small, plausible and arguably an improvement — which is exactly the case where a reviewer is tempted to wave it through. Different package means halt, not budget.
